newsitem.title: USA: Torricelli helicopter makes emergency N.J. stop.
newsitem.headline: Torricelli helicopter makes emergency N.J. stop.

text.p: A helicopter carrying Representative Robert Torricelli, the Democratic candidate in New Jersey's hotly Senate race, made an emergency landing Monday afternoon, his office said.
Torricelli was not injured, said spokesman Josh Isay. Around 2:30 p.m. the helicopter carrying Torricelli to an election eve campaign stop suffered a minor mechanical malfunction, Isay said.
"It was the equivalent of a flat tire in a helicopter," Isay said.
The helicopter made a normal landing in Robbinsville, N.J., and Torricelli resumed his campaign in a replacement helicopter, missing one stop at Brookdale College, Isay said.

Torricelli was running against Republican Representative Richard Zimmer for the seat vacated by retiring Democratic Sen. Bill Bradley. Polls show the race, which has been marked by a barrage of negative advertisements, to be too close to call.
